records.title: Claim file for Affordable housing funding will more than double from $52M to $125M annually
records.targetAgency: Mayor Budget Office / Controller / Department finance offices
records.ask: Request the primary records, methodology documents, internal memos, and published data needed to verify the claim "Affordable housing funding will more than double from $52M to $125M annually". Budget proposal PDFs, Board of Supervisors hearing packets, departmental spreadsheets, and final appropriations.
records.whyNow: Legislation introduced May 2026; track Board vote, November 2026 ballot outcome, and actual budget allocation
